d: Doug is left heartbroken when his girlfriend Susan calls off their relationship. One day, he comes across an injured duck and decides to take it to a vet, who he starts developing feelings for.

Small-town girl Lucy Jacobs has started her freshman year at a big-city university. When she returns home for Thanksgiving break, she suspects that she's about to get turkey dropped: dumped by her high-school sweetheart.
In a classic coming of age story, middle-schooler Erin pursues a crush on the new girl in town, leaving her best friend Liz feeling left out.
Paul is an actor who feels bogged down by his participation in a production of Chekov's play, Vanya.
